name: Régulateur des étapes
description: Short compact adult, deep brown speckled face, broad jaw, low head ridge, unique narrow bronze mask with small cheek vents, tied-back short dreads. Coarse sand-coloured hood down around neck, thick waist sash, leather-reinforced canvas tunic. Holds a bronze timing-and-route disk with restrained blue-glass center and a rolled unmarked route sheet. Side-mounted small supply bags; torso rotated slightly right.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce exactly ONE individual full-body adult Yautja NPC game sprite: a caravan QUARTERMASTER of the Peuple des Citernes desert tribe. Image1 is reference ONLY for this role's tribe materials and visual identity: sand-worn tan cloth wraps and capes, dark leather harness/pouches, patinated bronze travel protection, restrained blue-glass water flasks and practical caravan supplies. Image2 is reference ONLY for cinematic realistically handpainted 2D game rendering, body proportions, readable silhouette and slightly elevated three-quarter camera FACING RIGHT. One NEW distinct individual, never a recoloured copy. Canonical alien Yautja cranium, four mandibles when face is exposed, tendril dreadlocks and clawed hands/feet. Working logistics specialist in calm idle stance, not combat. All baggage must be physically attached, held or strapped; no loose items around character. Crisp silhouette, detailed convincing textiles and weathered metal, soft overhead-left lighting. Full body head-to-toes and ALL equipment must fit inside frame with at least8% empty margin every side; do not crop. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, backdrop, ground, platform, floor shadow, glow cloud, text, readable writing, numbers, labels, watermark, border, extra person, collage or atlas. No magical staff. At ordinary game sprite scale, face, posture, clothes and cargo shape must distinguish this person.
Distinct individual design: Short compact adult, deep brown speckled face, broad jaw, low head ridge, unique narrow bronze mask with small cheek vents, tied-back short dreads. Coarse sand-coloured hood down around neck, thick waist sash, leather-reinforced canvas tunic.
